core\tokens\data\ml.ts

ONNX Runtime Web / WebNN engine tokens — sole declaration
Sourcesrc/core\tokens\data\ml.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

EP_WEBNN

Execution-provider preference order — ORT picks the first live one.

ORT_IMPORT_SPEC

onnxruntime-web submodule specifier for the jsep (WebGPU+WebNN) bundle.

ORT_LOG_LEVEL

ORT logLevel — devNoise off, real failures still surface.

TENSOR_FLOAT32

Tensor element type string ORT expects for float32 tensors.

MODEL_EXT

Model file extension under the models prefix.

MODEL_INTENT

Model registry — slug → file under /models/<slug>.onnx emitted by gen-onnx-models.mjs. Keep names stable: the manifest and the runtime bind by slug.

IN_FEATURES

Input tensor name shared by every generated model.

SUPERRES_MAX_PIXELS

Super-res input cap — pixel marshaling runs on the main thread so sources stay thumb-sized (≤512² px); larger media already has the quality it needs.

IN_LR_IMAGE

Super-resolution model's image tensor names + geometry.

INTENT_FEATURE_DIM

Intent model feature layout: [hoverNorm, speedNorm, bias].

FRAMETIME_FEATURE_DIM

Frametime model feature layout: 5-frame window + current quality.

DIAGRAM_FEATURE_DIM

Diagram-cost feature layout: [nodeCount, edgeCount, nesting, selfMsgs].

OUT_PROBABILITY

Output tensor names for the generated models.

FRAME_NORM_MS

Frame-time prediction normalization — inputs are clamped to [0, FRAME_NORM_MS] then divided by it so the network sees 0–1. 100ms covers a fully dropped long task without clipping real spikes.

FRAMETIME_INFER_EVERY

Inference cadence — one pass per N frames keeps ORT off the tick.

FRAME_BUDGET_HI

Predicted-ms thresholds (normalized /100) that move quality.

QUALITY_MIN

Quality bounds + step sizes — pixel-ratio multiplier 0.5–1.0.

DIAGRAM_NORM_NODES

Diagram-cost: features normalized by these before inference.

DIAGRAM_DEFER_MS

Render-time threshold (ms) above which a diagram defers to idle.

MIN_ES_TIER

Minimum ES bundle tier for ML inference — the enhancements are modern-browser-only progressive layers; the loader-stamped tier (window.__LK_TIER) below this year never fetches the ORT chunk and keeps the heuristic path. 'esnext' always qualifies.

TIER_PREFIX

Tier-name prefix and the non-numeric newest tier name.

WINDOW_TIER

Window property the ES5 browser-loader stamps with the picked tier name.

ML_SESSION

ORT session-option literal names — the executionProviders array and graphOptimizationLevel enum value live here so no string is repeated between the engine and its tests.

WEBNN_DEVICE

WebNN deviceType hint passed to the EP — matches npu-predict's probe.
